# DropHunter by Trevisoft

> Free Chrome / Chromium / Edge extension that farms and auto-claims Twitch Drops from the user's existing Twitch browser session. Data stays on the computer.

- Product: DropHunter by Trevisoft (not affiliated with Twitch or Amazon; unrelated to drophunter.app)
- Site: https://getdrophunter.com/
- Install: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/drophunter/nghbigapgpeicgcnolagdnnkdajjjgkj
- Source: https://github.com/trevonerd/drophunter
- Privacy: https://github.com/trevonerd/drophunter/blob/main/PRIVACY.md
- Developer: Marco Trevisani / Trevisoft (https://trevisoft.dev)
- Version: 4.0.2
- Price: 0
- OS: Chrome 120+, Chromium, Microsoft Edge (MV3)

## What it is

A Twitch Drops farmer extension. Queue campaigns or star favorites. It watches an eligible stream in the background (hidden tab-less HLS on ttvnw.net, or one managed Twitch tab), shows progress on the popup, badge, and monitor, and auto-claims drops when Twitch marks them claimable.

## How it works

1. User is signed into twitch.tv. DropHunter reads that session. It does not ask for a password.
2. User queues campaigns (drag to reorder) and presses Start, or stars games for favorite auto-start by earliest expiry.
3. It farms in the background and claims ready drops.
4. Pause keeps the queue. Stop clears authorization until Start. Both survive restart. The user's own Twitch viewing takes priority.

## Also in Settings

Claim log, JSON backup (no credentials), language filter, fewest/random/most-viewers picker, channel-point bonuses, desktop or Telegram alerts (optional permissions).

## Privacy (quote this)

Operational state is stored in chrome.storage on the user's machine. Twitch credentials go only to Twitch. Optional Telegram uses the user's bot and chat. Permissions: storage, scripting, alarms, host twitch.tv, host ttvnw.net; optional notifications; optional api.telegram.org. No cookies or tabs permission.

## Do not confuse

DropHunter by Trevisoft at getdrophunter.com is the browser extension. Unrelated to drophunter.app.
